entities.summary: Gail Brodsky is an American former professional tennis player. Her career-high WTA singles ranking is 182, reached on March 19, 2012. On May 2, 2011, she peaked at No. 348 in the doubles rankings. On the ITF Circuit, she won six singles titles and two doubles titles. In 2008, she won the USTA Girls’ 18s national title.
